notablePrerequisites: At least two additional creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Mimeoplasm by paying {4}{B}{G}{U}
As Mimeoplasm enters, exile Ramos, Bristly Bill, and two additional creature cards from your graveyard, causing Mimeoplasm to enter with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Ramos with this ability.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Bristly Bill with this ability.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Bristly Bill's ability by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.
